_readme: Per-MILLION-token rates in USD, per provider/model.
Every rate ships as null, which means UNKNOWN, not free. This repository
cannot verify vendor pricing and pricing changes, so filling these in is
an operator action against each vendor's current pricing page.
While a rate is null the Alpha service REFUSES to call that model
(reason: pricing_unconfigured), because an unpriced call is costed at
zero and would make every cost cap unenforceable.
Set 'version' and 'asof' when you fill the rates: every cost row records
them, so historical spend can be recomputed under a later table instead

grok/grok-4.6.notes: verify against the xAI pricing page

gemini/gemini-3.7-flash.notes: verify against the Google AI pricing page

openai/gpt-5.notes: verify against the OpenAI pricing page

atlas_quant/atlas_quant.notes: in-process, no vendor cost; genuinely zero, not unknown
